results.name: The Legend of Tarzan
results.overview: The Legend of Tarzan picks up where the 1999 feature film left off, with the title character adjusting to his new role as leader of the apes following Kerchak's death, and Jane adjusting to life in the jungle. Rounding out the cast are Jane's father, Professor Archimedes Porter; Tantor, the germophobic elephant; and Terk, a wisecracking female gorilla and Tarzan's old wrestling buddy.

results.title: The Legend of Tarzan
results.overview: Tarzan, having acclimated to life in London, is called back to his former home in the jungle to investigate the activities at a mining encampment.

results.title: Greystoke: The Legend of Tarzan, Lord of the Apes
results.original_title: Greystoke: The Legend of Tarzan, Lord of the Apes
results.overview: A shipping disaster in the 19th Century has stranded a man and woman in the wilds of Africa. The lady is pregnant, and gives birth to a son in their tree house. Soon after, a family of apes stumble across the house and in the ensuing panic, both parents are killed. A female ape takes the tiny boy as a replacement for her own dead infant, and raises him as her son. Twenty years later, Captain Phillippe D'Arnot discovers the man who thinks he is an ape. Evidence in the tree house leads him to believe that he is the direct descendant of the Earl of Greystoke, and thus takes it upon himself to return the man to civilization.

results.title: Lord of the Jungle
results.overview: The film starts off with a woman and a baby on a plane. The plane, for no apparent reason, fails and crashes into a jungle. The baby survives and is adopted and brought home by a gorilla named Shina. She brings him to her troop, where he is ridiculed for being different from the rest of them. The yet to be named baby is allowed to stay on the condition that he is to go if he causes any trouble. Shina names him Lord and he quickly adjusts to life as a gorilla.

results.name: La leyenda de Tarzán
results.overview: Basada en la película de animación de Disney, esta serie explora la vida en la jungla de este héroe de la literatura, Jane su amada, el profesor Porter y todos los animales compañeros de Tarzán.

results.title: La leyenda de Tarzán
results.overview: Tarzán, ya acostumbrado a la vida en Londres, es llamado de vuelta a su antiguo hogar en la selva para investigar las actividades que se llevan a cabo en un campamento minero.

results.title: Tarzán 2: El origen de la leyenda
results.overview: Antes de ser el Rey de la Selva, Tarzán era un niño inquieto que intentaba encontrar su papel en el mundo. Cuando una de sus travesuras pone a su familia en peligro, Tarzán decide que ellos estarán mejor sin él. Así se embarca en un emocionante viaje que le llevará a encontrarse cara a cara con el misterioso Zugor, la fuerza más poderosa del planeta. Juntos, Tarzán y Zugor descubren que ser diferentes no es una debilidad y que los amigos y la familia son el mayor apoyo de todos.

results.title: Greystoke: La leyenda de Tarzán, el rey de los monos
results.original_title: Greystoke: The Legend of Tarzan, Lord of the Apes
results.overview: Año 1886. Tras un naufragio frente a las costas de África, el heredero de la familia Greystoke, John Clayton, huérfano a los pocos meses de nacer, es adoptado por una tribu de simios, entre los que vive durante años. Descubierto por el Capitán D’Arnot, el joven Tarzán es llevado a Inglaterra, presentado a su familia y educado de acuerdo con su rango.

results.name: Machos alfa
results.overview: Pedro, Luis, Raúl y Santi son cuatro amigos que se sienten perdidos en la nueva era de empoderamiento femenino y que luchan por adaptarse, cada uno a su propia —y caótica— manera.

results.title: Alfa
results.overview: Una aventura épica y una historia de supervivencia ambientada en la Europa de hace 20.000 años, durante la última glaciación. En mitad de su primera cacería con el grupo de élite de su tribu, un joven es herido y dado por muerto. Al despertar se encontrará débil y solo, y deberá aprender a sobrevivir y abrirse camino ante la dura y cruel naturaleza. Acompañado a regañadientes de un lobo abandonado por su manada, los dos aprenderán a confiar el uno en el otro, convertirse en aliados y superar los innumerables peligros para intentar encontrar el camino a casa antes de que llegue el letal invierno.

results.title: Alfa y Omega
results.overview: Los guardabosques del parque capturan a Kate, una cachorra de lobo alfa y a Humphrey, un lobo omega, ambos terminan en una tierra teniendo que encontrar su camino a casa.

results.title: Macho Alfa
results.overview: Animado por su prometida, Piotrek decide inscribirse a un programa para lograr dejar de fumar, pero termina matriculándose a un curso de autodescubrimiento. Bajo la influencia de un carismático líder, él empieza a cuestionarse qué tan perfecta es su relación con su futura esposa.

results.title: Alfa & Bravo
results.overview: Un mercenario que se esconde de un peligroso cartel y un mototaxista local se ven obligados a unir fuerzas para rescatar a sus "novias" secuestradas.

known_for.title: En el mejor momento
known_for.overview: Harta de transitar el mundo de las citas acompañada de sus amigos, una chica encantadora con un raro trastorno genético se propone enamorar al chico más guapo de todos.

results.title: Código Alfa
results.overview: Johana, una mujer sin pasado, se esconde del agente de la ONU Bowie, jefe de un programa espacial secreto. En su carrera, se encuentra con Martin y, con la ayuda del excolega de Bowie, Lance, ambos ayudan a Martin a encontrar a su hija medio alienígena.

results.title: Proyecto alfa
results.overview: Después de que una misteriosa bacteria infectara el planeta, las zonas de seguridad intentan aprovecharse de las personas más desfavorecidas, lo que provoca varias rebeliones. Se crean supersoldados para proteger la cura de los insurgentes.

results.title: Jurassic World Rebirth
results.overview: Five years after the events of Jurassic World Dominion, covert operations expert Zora Bennett is contracted to lead a skilled team on a top-secret mission to secure genetic material from the world's three most massive dinosaurs. When Zora's operation intersects with a civilian family whose boating expedition was capsized, they all find themselves stranded on an island where they come face-to-face with a sinister, shocking discovery that's been hidden from the world for decades.

results.name: Jurassic World: Chaos Theory
results.overview: The Camp Cretaceous gang comes together to unravel a mystery when they discover a global conspiracy that brings danger to dinosaurs — and to themselves.

results.title: Jurassic World
results.overview: Twenty-two years after the events of Jurassic Park, Isla Nublar now features a fully functioning dinosaur theme park, Jurassic World, as originally envisioned by John Hammond.

results.name: Jurassic World Camp Cretaceous
results.overview: Six teens attending an adventure camp on the opposite side of Isla Nublar must band together to survive when dinosaurs wreak havoc on the island.

results.title: Jurassic World Dominion
results.overview: Four years after Isla Nublar was destroyed, dinosaurs now live—and hunt—alongside humans all over the world. This fragile balance will reshape the future and determine, once and for all, whether human beings are to remain the apex predators on a planet they now share with history's most fearsome creatures.

results.title: Jurassic World: Fallen Kingdom
results.overview: Three years after Jurassic World was destroyed, Isla Nublar now sits abandoned. When the island's dormant volcano begins roaring to life, Owen and Claire mount a campaign to rescue the remaining dinosaurs from this extinction-level event.

results.name: LEGO: Jurassic World - Legend of Isla Nublar
results.original_name: LEGO Jurassic World: Legend of Isla Nublar
results.overview: Set in 2012, three years before the Jurassic World movie, Owen Grady and Claire Dearing team up on Isla Nublar to deal with everything the Jurassic World park throws their way, including a mysterious saboteur who wants to destroy the park forever!

results.name: LEGO Jurassic World: The Secret Exhibit
results.original_name: LEGO Jurassic World: The Secret Exhibit
results.overview: It's 2012, and Simon Masrani has an idea for a new attraction that is guaranteed to keep Jurassic World at the forefront of theme park entertainment. It's the greatest thing since the discovery of dinosaurs, but in order for it to succeed, he needs his right-hand, can-do problem solver, Claire Dearing, to get a trio of dinosaurs across the park to the new, super-secret exhibit. Reluctantly teaming up with newcomer Owen Grady, the animal behaviorist she hired sight unseen to deliver the dinosaurs, the duo sets out on a fun-filled adventure across the island. Unfortunately, delivering the dinosaurs to the new attraction is not as easy as they thought.

results.title: Jurassic World Camp Cretaceous: Hidden Adventure
results.original_title: Jurassic World Camp Cretaceous: Hidden Adventure
results.overview: After a big storm, food is scarce — and hungry dinos are everywhere. It's up to you to help the Camp Fam survive in this thrilling interactive special.

results.title: Untitled Jurassic World Rebirth Sequel
results.overview: Eighth installment in the Jurassic franchise, set to shoot in 2027. Plot details TBA.

results.title: LEGO Jurassic World: The Indominus Escape
results.original_title: LEGO Jurassic World: The Indominus Escape
results.overview: The scientists of Jurassic World create a captivating and terrifying new creature that loves hot dogs. But what happens when the hot dogs run out?

results.name: LEGO Jurassic World: Double Trouble
results.overview: LEGO Jurassic World is open for business, but with a few changes. A sibling rivalry has lead to new management, but things get out of hand quick when the new boss goes off the rails.

results.title: Jurassic World Dominion Prologue
results.overview: Jurassic World Dominion: The Prologue is five-minute prologue to the 2022 film Jurassic World: Dominion that was released in 2021, initially as an IMAX-exclusive preview and later as an online short film

results.title: Lego Jurassic World: Double Trouble
results.overview: O.O.P.S.I., the new artificial intelligence running the Park, goes dangerously off the rails, while a thief posing as an intern steals two eggs that contain a new species of dinosaur inside.

results.title: Jurassic Greatest Moments: Jurassic Park to Jurassic World
results.original_title: Jurassic Greatest Moments: Jurassic Park to Jurassic World
results.overview: Join the cast of "Jurassic World Dominion" as they relive their favorite unforgettable, action-packed and epic moments from the "Jurassic World" franchise.

results.title: The Lost World: Jurassic Park
results.overview: Four years after Jurassic Park's genetically bred dinosaurs ran amok, multimillionaire John Hammond shocks chaos theorist Ian Malcolm by revealing that he has been breeding more beasties at a secret location. Malcolm, his paleontologist ladylove and a wildlife videographer join an expedition to document the lethal lizards' natural behavior in this action-packed thriller.

results.title: LEGO Jurassic World: Rescue Blue
results.overview: What happens when you try to find a dinosaur on an exploding Isla Nublar?

results.title: Jurassic World Rebirth: The Making of a New Era
results.original_title: Jurassic World Rebirth: The Making of a New Era
results.overview: A behind-the-scenes look with the cast and crew, featuring thrilling locations, deadly new dinosaurs and the next evolution of the iconic franchise.

results.name: Jurassic World (Motion Comics)
results.overview: Get ready to journey back into the growing Jurassic World, this time in 'motion comic' form. This entry explores new content not tied to the core characters of the films, however directly tied to the events they partook in.

results.title: The Making of Jurassic World VelociCoaster
results.original_title: The Making of Jurassic World VelociCoaster
results.overview: An inside look at the creation of Universal Orlando Resort's new Jurassic World VelociCoaster.

data.title: Jurassic World
data.overview: Veintidós años después de lo ocurrido en Jurassic Park, la isla Nublar ha sido transformada en un enorme parque temático, Jurassic Wold, con versiones «domesticadas» de algunos de los dinosaurios más conocidos. Cuando todo parece ir sobre ruedas y ser el negocio del siglo, un nuevo dinosaurio de especie desconocida, pues ha sido creado manipulando genéticamente su ADN, y que resulta ser mucho más inteligente de lo que se pensaba, se escapa de su recinto y comienza a causar estragos entre los visitantes del Parque

results.name: The Flash
results.overview: After being struck by lightning, CSI investigator Barry Allen awakens from a nine-month coma to discover he has been  granted the gift of super speed.  Teaming up with S.T.A.R. Labs, Barry takes on the persona of The Flash, the Fastest  Man Alive, to protect his city.

results.title: The Flash
results.overview: When his attempt to save his family inadvertently alters the future, Barry Allen becomes trapped in a reality in which General Zod has returned and there are no Super Heroes to turn to. In order to save the world that he is in and return to the future that he knows, Barry's only hope is to race for his life. But will making the ultimate sacrifice be enough to reset the universe?

results.name: The Flash
results.overview: When a bolt of lightning crashes through a police crime lab, a mix of electrically charged substances bathes chemist Barry Allen, transforming him into the fastest man alive--The Flash.

known_for.title: The Flaming Signal
known_for.overview: A pilot and his dog crash-land on an island run by a psycho who owns a motel--and most of the locals.

known_for.title: Under the Black Eagle
known_for.overview: A German Shepherd Dog and the people he loves are entangled in World War One.

known_for.title: His Master's Voice
known_for.overview: A loyal German Shepherd dog follows his master to the French front in World War One.

known_for.title: Silks and Saddles
known_for.overview: College student Jimmy Shaw inherits a racehorse, named Lightning Lad, and sells stock to fellow students in order to obtain funds for racing the horse. Lightning Lad wins very race he is entered in. Marion Braddock, a spoiled rich girl who owns a racing stable offers to buy Lightning Lad, but Jimmy refuses to sell. The day of the big handicap-race arrives and Jimmy and his fellow stockholders are on their way to the track. But a group of gamblers, betting on Lightning Lad to lose, have some skullduggery plans to ensure Lightning Lad does not win the race.

results.title: The Flash
results.overview: A laboratory accident endows a police scientist with the ability to move at superhuman speed which he uses to battle a menacing gang as a superhero.

results.name: The Flash Band
results.overview: In the program, the musicians participated in the festival in the form of a band. During the process, they continued to run in and reorganize, and collided with music works that broke through the classics, and finally formed a shining band.

results.title: Ricki and the Flash
results.overview: Meryl Streep stars as Ricki Rendazzo, a guitar heroine who made a world of mistakes as she followed her dreams of rock-and-roll stardom. Returning home, Ricki gets a shot at redemption and a chance to make things right as she faces the music with her family.

results.title: The Flash
results.overview: After being struck by a lightning, scientist Barry Allen becomes The Flash, and while fighting villains, he has to resolve a mistery from his past.

results.name: The Flash
results.overview: 2 Years After Being Struck By Lightning, Barry Allen Has Become The Hero Known As THE FLASH.

results.title: The Cherokee Flash
results.overview: Lawyer Butler, wanting Jeff Carson's ranch, has the Sheriff and his gang frame the bank holdup on him. Then they kill a witness that could free Carson and blame the murder on his son Sunset. But Sunset escapes, frees his father, and then sets a trap to catch the real killers.

results.title: The Flash
results.overview: Blind Carl Bauer is on the verge of regaining his sight. But in a moment of impulsive action tears off his bandages in order to save his daughter from a villain, ultimately losing his chance at vision forever.

results.title: The Green Flash
results.overview: When a runaway orphan encounters a hoodlum on-the-lamb in Coney Island, their chance encounter becomes a life changing event for them both.

results.name: The Flash: Stretched Scene
results.overview: The Flash: Stretched Scene, simply known as Stretched Scene, is a mini-series, focusing on Ralph Dibny, that aired during commercial breaks of the fourth season of The Flash, as well as online. The web series premiered on November 14, 2017, alongside the broadcast of The Flash episode "When Harry Met Harry...", as well as on CWTV.com. The web series was presented by Microsoft to promote "The New Surface Pro". It features Hartley Sawyer as Ralph Dibny, and other cast members reprising their roles in Team Flash. The series follows Ralph pestering his teammates, testing out his new powers, and engaging in other crazy antics.

results.title: Flash in the Pain
results.overview: Wile E. Coyote receives an ACME Transporter, a teleportation device worn on the forearm and tries to catch the Road Runner.

results.title: Flash, The Teenage Otter
results.overview: Created for Walt Disney Presents television series then expanded by popular demand into a full feature, Flash, the Teenage Otter follows one of Disney’s most beloved animal stars as he strikes out from his home at a Wisconsin wildlife sanctuary to see the wider world with all of its wonders and perils.

results.title: The Big Flash
results.overview: Would-be photographer Harry gets his big chance when a newspaper wants pictures of a prominent gangster and his girl. Harry and another photographer first visit the gangster's girl, and then wait at the scene of an expected robbery. But before they can get the pictures they want, they must first distract a policeman whose presence would otherwise deter the gangster from appearing.

results.title: The Hot Flash
results.overview: Menopause turns a hot flashin' wallflower into a super-hot superhero.

results.title: Flash and the Firecat
results.overview: Gang of robbers use dune buggies for their big heist.

results.title: Flash Before the Bang
results.overview: The coming-of-age drama tells the true story of an all-deaf high school track & field team from the Oregon School for the Deaf. The team overcame discrimination and adversity on their way to an unprecedented victory against much larger Oregon public schools—becoming the Oregon State Track & Field Champions in 1986.

results.name: Flash
results.overview: Después de haber sido impactado por un rayo, Barry Allen se despierta del coma y descubre que tiene el poder de súper velocidad, convirtiéndose en Flash para combatir el crimen en Central City.

results.title: Flash
results.overview: Cuando su intento de salvar a su familia altera el futuro sin darse cuenta, Barry Allen queda atrapado en una realidad en la que el general Zod ha regresado y no hay superhéroes a los que recurrir. En última instancia, para salvar el mundo en el que se encuentra y regresar al futuro que conoce, la única esperanza de Barry es escapar de él para salvar su vida. Pero, ¿será suficiente hacer el último sacrificio para reiniciar el universo?

results.name: Flash
results.overview: Cuando un rayo atraviesa un laboratorio criminalístico de la policía, una mezcla de sustancias cargadas eléctricamente baña al químico Barry Allen, transformándolo en el hombre más rápido del mundo: Flash.

results.name: Las Nuevas Aventuras de Flash Gordon
results.overview: Flash Gordon, Dale Arden y el Dr. Hans Zarkov viajan al planeta Mongo para detener los planes del malvado emperador Ming "El Desalmado", su hija, la princesa Aura, y su ejército de hombres del metal . Para lograrlo, Flash forma una Alianza con el Rey Thun (Jefe de los Hijos del León), el Príncipe Barin (Gobernante de Arboria) y el Rey Vultan, líder de los Hawkmen.

results.name: Dirty Pair Flash
results.overview:
Kei y Yuri eran originalmente agentes auxiliares novatas de la Agencia Mundial de Obras y Bienestar (W.W.W.A., o 3WA, por sus siglas en inglés), hasta que fueron asignadas como compañeras bajo el nombre clave de «Lovely Angels». Kei acababa de recibir su cuarta sanción disciplinaria por algo que había hecho, mientras que las aventuras amorosas de Yuri eran de sobra conocidas. Por si fuera poco, ambas sintieron una antipatía instantánea cuando se conocieron.

Al principio, Kei y Yuri se negaron a trabajar juntas, e incluso Kei llegó a renunciar a la 3WA. Sin embargo, finalmente continuaron trabajando en equipo, aunque se ganaron el apodo de «Dirty Pair» debido a los daños colaterales que provocaban involuntariamente cada vez que resolvían un caso. Y aunque ahora se llevan mejor, siguen discutiendo y quejándose constantemente la una de la otra.

results.title: Flash Gordon
results.overview: A pesar de que los científicos de la NASA aseguran que el inesperado eclipse y el extraño "granizo caliente" no son de preocupación, el Dr. Hans Zarkov (Topol) sabe más y llama a la estrella de fútbol Flash Gordon (Sam Jones) y al agente viajero Dale Arden (Melody Anderson) para viajar al espacio y rectificar las cosas. Ellos aterrizan en el planeta Mongo, en donde el déspota Ming el Despiadado (Max von Sydow) está atacando a la Tierra. El equipo lucha para salvar a su planeta natal

results.title: Flash Point
results.overview: El inspector de policía Ma (Donnie Yen), cuyas violentas maneras le han valido la apertura de un expediente, se encuentra asignado a un caso de tráfico de drogas. Infiltrado en la banda, su colega Wilson (Louis Koo) ha logrado la detención de uno de sus miembros pero, con dos hombres todavía en libertad, mantener la seguridad dará lugar a un rosario de trepidantes persecuciones y furibundos combates...

results.title: Flashman, el heroico cobarde
results.overview: Otto von Bismarck contrata los servicios de Flashman para que realice una peligrosa misión: se trata de suplantar a un príncipe germano con el que Flashman tiene un extraordinario parecido. Una vez conseguido su objetivo, Bismarck intentará asesinar a Flashman y al príncipe para conseguir la unificación de los estados alemanes.

results.title: The Flash
results.overview: Un accidente de laboratorio otorga a un científico policial la capacidad de moverse a una velocidad sobrehumana que utiliza para luchar como superhéroe contra una pandilla amenazadora.

results.title: Sálvese quien pueda
results.overview: Terry Dolittle trabaja en un banco y usa los ordenadores para comunicarse con clientes de todo el mundo. Un día recibe un extraño mensaje de un remitente desconocido. Después de descodificarlo, Terry se ve envuelta en una trama de espionaje en la que resultarán asesinadas varias personas y le obligará a emprender la huida.

results.title: The Unspoken
results.overview: In 1997 the close-knit Anderson family vanished from their home without a trace. No bodies were ever found and no explanation satisfied curiosity. For 17 years the house has remained undisturbed...until now. This eerily expert frightener is further enlivened by terrific performances from ‘Suits’/’Arrow’ star Neal McDonough and SILENT HILL/THE TALL MAN/TIDELAND’s Jodelle Ferland.

results.title: The Unspoken
results.overview: In the summer of 1969, an unspeakable crime was committed in the small oil two of Black Diamond. The culprit was never caught. Twenty-fives years later, the town is being torn apart by two feuding oil barons. A young journalist enters the scene. He digs into the town's terrible past and promising to set the town aflame.

results.title: The Unspoken
results.overview: Jean, a small-town child preacher grows up in an institution without speaking. When involuntarily released, he ends up in an abandoned motel where he meets Cory – a “hard knocks” woman. Together they embark on a strange journey of healing.

results.title: The Unspoken Truth
results.overview: Despite her parents' misgivings, Brianne marries Clay, and the couple soon have a daughter. It's then that Clay begins to show the first signs that he's unhinged. When he sees Brianne innocently talking to a man, Clay shoots him dead. At first, Brianne believes that her love for her husband can prevail. But when authorities threaten to take away custody of her daughter, she learns a horrible truth about her past.

results.title: The Unspoken
results.overview: Faced with an unplanned pregnancy, a young woman is forced to examine her future, her relationship, and the painful complexity behind the decision to have an abortion.

results.title: The Unspoken
results.overview: A mother confronts her boyfriend about his uncomfortably intense relationship with her young daughter during what was supposed to be a romantic dinner date.

results.title: The Unspoken
results.overview: Renowned Indian astrologer Jyotibhaskar Pandit Satyanarayan Chaturvedi, wishes a doctor, who is about to perform surgery on a woman, good luck, but also tells him that his patient is going to die. The doctor scoffs at this, and proceeds to the operation theatre. The patient dies, and the doctor is humbled before the astrologer. The astrologer lives with his wife, Devki, and an only son, Nandu. Nandu is of marriageable age, and he would like to see him get married to a woman named Indu Agnihotri. But Nandu loves another woman by the name of Sushma Chatopadhya and is determined to marry her. And then his father tells him that he is fated to have two wives in this lifetime - the first will die within eleven months of the marriage - and that's when he will re-marry. Modern-day educated Nandu must now decide to believe his father and let go of Sushma, or defy his astrological beliefs and marry her.

results.title: The Unspoken Path
results.overview: The Unspoken Path is a tender short film in British Sign Language about love, distance, and the things left unsaid. Over an intimate dinner, one person struggles to reveal life-changing news — a new job abroad — but discovers that love is stronger than fear. Written and directed by first-time filmmaker Nicole Kenny and produced through Solar Bear’s Solar Reels film school, this moving story captures the quiet power of connection.

results.title: The Unspoken
results.overview: Interviews with the last living contemporary witnesses of the Nazi era, focusing on those who were involved at the time, the followers and accomplices of the regime. Almost no one from this generation ever spoke about that time after 1945; in German families, the subject was taboo—the unspoken.

results.title: The Toilet: An Unspoken History
results.overview: Welsh poet Ifor Ap Glyn has a passionate interest in the toilet: its history and how it has evolved over the centuries, right up to the development of the current design. Here, he explains the reasons behind his fascination.

results.title: The Unspoken Wounds
results.overview: Saad (16) is a teenage boy who has become the backbone of his family, caring for his younger sister, Asih (10), and his grandmother (60), who has long struggled with mental illness. Growing up without parental figures, he lacks an emotional connection with both his sister and grandmother. However, a tragic event involving Asih forces Saad to confront his own neglect and realize the importance of protecting his family. The film is inspired by a traditional Sundanese song titled Hihid Kabuyutan, which conveys a meaningful moral about mutual care within a family.

results.title: The Unspoken Secret
results.overview: He Jidong was drunk at a friend's party. When he woke up, the police had already appeared and found the diamond ring lost by his friend that night in his pocket. All the evidence and motives pointed to He Jidong, and He Jidong was imprisoned as a result. Two years later He Jidong was released from prison, his wife Jiaqi had divorced him. All of his friends and relatives also refused to deal with him.  He Jidong's mother, however, asked a friend to find him a job on a construction site. He Jidong came to a low point in his life, but there is a woman who has been quietly concerned about him, accompany him. She is He Jidong's first girlfriend in college, Wang Fang.

results.title: Traces of the Unspoken
results.overview: Sakiran (11), left behind by his parents, slips out of the house and meets a friend who takes him to a PS2 rental. Yet the joy of playing can’t replace the warmth of the family he quietly longs for.

results.title: The Journey of Eva's Unspoken Words
results.original_title: A Viagem das Palavras Não Ditas de Eva
results.overview: Routine imprisoned Eva in an automatism that was ingrained in her spirit. Dromomania will perhaps be the expression that best illustrates her condition. She feels absent, and her frivolous glance catalogs each one of the small details of the journey that imprisons her every day. Her apathetic state is interrupted when she crosses an object outside the street and Eva is forced to finally face her demons.

results.name: The Fearless
results.overview: Luo Yingzi, a self-taught lawyer who, after personal setbacks, teams up with Qiu Hua and Xia Shu to fight for justice, navigating both legal challenges and their own personal struggles

results.title: Things We Don't Say
results.overview: Carlo and Elisa are a successful couple. He’s a university professor and writer facing a creative block; she’s a brilliant, sharp-witted journalist, known for her internationally published editorials. They live in Rome, moving between accomplishments and routine, affection and something that might be fading. In search of new energy, they travel to Morocco with their lifelong friends, Anna and Paolo, and their thirteen-year-old daughter Vittoria—bright, curious, a little eccentric. Tensions soon rise.

results.title: Just for the Time Being
results.overview: A beautiful woman comes between a father and son. When both men begin to compete for her affections, a dangerous love triangle develops and she must choose between them.

results.title: The Legend of Herring
results.overview: Liu Qian Zhi, a disciple of the Buyu Sect who subdues demons and slays demons, accidentally met Xiao Qing, a fish demon who wanted to cultivate into a dragon. Xiao Qing lied that she was also a demon exorcist in order to prevent others from discovering her identity as a fish demon. After that, the two set on a journey together and experienced various difficulties and obstacles.

results.overview: En 1997, la familia Anderson desapareció de su hogar sin dejar rastro. No se encontraron nunca los cuerpos. Durante 17 años la casa ha permanecido inalterada ... hasta ahora.

results.title: Rambo: First Blood Part II
results.overview: John Rambo is released from prison by the government for a top-secret covert mission to the last place on Earth he'd want to return - the jungles of Vietnam.

results.overview: An eccentric genius and a demoted special forces officer team up in Tokyo's Unidentified Crimes Unit to tackle criminals with supernatural abilities.

results.title: Blood First
results.overview: Two brothers love and loyalty to one another is tested by the code of the streets.

results.name: First Blood
results.overview: “First Blood" examines some of America’s most notorious serial killers through the prism of their first known kills to reveal what drove them to the moment when violent fantasy and curiosity became a devastating reality.

results.title: First Blood
results.overview: A teenage girl goes through a bizarre transformation after she gets her first period.

results.title: BRB: First Blood
results.overview: Once upon a time in 2209 A.D.

results.name: Bloody Bunny The First Blood
results.overview: Bloody Bunny is a knife-wielding rabbit with the vengeful soul of a quiet little girl who travels on a perilous journey across a dark land to find and destroy her malevolent creator and return to a human body - all whilst kicking the crap out of and killing a lot of monsters along the way.

results.title: First Blood
results.overview: After being dumped a man decides to become a serial killer, but he's very unqualified.

results.title: Camp Blood First Slaughter
results.overview: A group of students on a class assignment travel to the infamous Camp Blood woods in the hopes of debunking a local legend.

results.title: The Making of 'First Blood'
results.overview: This documentary takes a behind-the-scenes look at the making of "First Blood", the film about a Vietnam veteran pushed too far that started the Rambo series of the 1980's. Includes interviews with stars Sylvester Stallone, Richard Crenna and Brian Dennehy, as well as other members of the cast and crew, who talk about the effort that went into making the finished film.

results.title: Sin: First Blood
results.overview: Tosin Shina, a glamorous Lagos socialite and nightclub owner, sees her perfect life shatter when her husband is arrested as a top drug trafficker. With her wealth gone and children to protect, she’s forced to rebuild. But when a deadly cartel demands she take over her husband’s operations, Tosin must navigate crime, betrayal, and survival—or lose everything.

results.title: Until First Blood
results.overview: War game is a summer camp gets unexpected turn...

results.title: First Blood
results.overview: The majority of women are unhappy in life because they haven’t sought revenge right away for the pain associated with the loss of virginity. This is the opinion of Lisa, who will sacrifice her first love.

results.title: Jatisari First Blood
results.overview: A short film by Sirojuddin

results.title: Rupert: First Blood

results.title: Drawing First Blood: 20 Years Later
results.overview: Twenty years later, the cast and crew of 'First Blood' look back on the making of the first Rambo film. Featuring Sylvester Stallone, Richard Crenna, director Ted Kotcheff, producers Mario Kassar and Andrew Vanja.

results.title: Jatisari First Blood Reloaded
results.overview: Without clear reason, Corporal Jono is being held as a hostage by Jatisari Gangster. With his magic, Sergeant Rebo succeeded to free him.

results.title: Adelaide Crows First Blood
results.overview: It was never easy and it was always controversial, but in the end the birth of the Adelaide Crows - the AFL's 15th team - was one of the most exciting initiatives undertaken. With Queensland, New South Wales and Western Australia already joining Victoria in the national competition, the last hitch was coming to terms with the proud South Australians - a state divided on the debate about whether or not it should enter the expanding AFL. The issue was one of the hottest topics in football, but now, with Adelaide crowing in joyful chorus after its initial success, the genesis of the Crows is complete and a magnificent chapter in football history has begun.  The entire four quarters of the Adelaide Crows first victory of the 1991 home and away season.

results.title: Rambo IV: Regreso al infierno
results.overview: John Rambo, el ex-boina verde con una ajetreada vida marcada por la guerra, vive ahora una solitaria y apacible existencia en la jungla del norte de Tailandia, pescando y cazando cobras para luego venderlas. Todo cambia cuando un grupo de misioneros católicos necesita que les guíe hasta la frontera con Birmania para suministrar medicinas y alimentos a unos refugiados asediados por el ejército birmano, que ha hecho de las torturas y los asesinatos algo habitual. Rambo no tendrá más remedio que volver a involucrarse. Se verá obligado a hacer lo que mejor sabe porque, muy a su pesar, lleva la guerra en la sangre.

results.title: Rambo
results.overview: Cuando John Rambo, el ex Bere Verde, es acosado por la policía local y arrestado por vagancia, el veterano de Vietnam escapa de la policía y corre por las colinas, donde se desarrolla una guerra ente Rambo y la policía de ese pueblo. Acosado por un incansable sheriff, Rambo emplea tácticas de guerrilla duras para sacudir a los policías.

results.title: Rambo III
results.overview: Cuando descubre que el coronel Trautman ha caído en manos soviéticas en Afganistán, Rambo regresa al servicio para intentar liberar a su amigo. Después de contactar a la resistencia afgana, entra en la zona sitiada por las tropas enemigas…

results.name: Rambo: La Fuerza de la Libertad
results.overview: Un Grupo de héroes llamado la "Fuerza de la Libertad", que bajo el mando del Coronel Samuel Trautman luchan en misiones alrededor del mundo contra una organización paramilitar y terrorista llamada S.A.V.A.G.E. (abreviatura en inglés de Specialist-Administrators of Vengeance, Anarchy and Global Extortion), cuyo jefe militar es el maléfico General Warhawk. Rambo y su equipo bregarán por la paz y la justicia.

results.title: Rambo II - La misión
results.overview: Rambo, encarcelado por sus antiguos crímenes, recibe por parte del coronel Trautman la misión optativa de ir a Vietnam para comprobar si aún quedan prisioneros de guerra. Si la misión saliera bien, el presidente le concedería el perdón, y así sería libre. Rambo acepta. Está bajo las órdenes de un falso teniente (Murdock), al que muy en el fondo sólo le interesa el dinero y el poder de su nación, y al que le da igual perder a unos cuantos hombres, por muy inocentes que sean, si sigue controlando las cosas como él quiere. Murdock le encarga que sólo saque fotos, y que no ataque al enemigo. Pero al saltar en paracaídas sobre un área selvática prohibida, Rambo pierde todo su equipo, excepto un cuchillo dentado y un arco.

results.title: Rambo: Last Blood
results.overview: Después de luchar contra sus demonios durante décadas, John Rambo vive ahora en paz en su rancho familiar en Arizona, pero su descanso se ve interrumpido cuando Gabriela, la nieta de su ama de llaves María, desaparece después de cruzar la frontera con México con el propósito de conocer a su padre biológico. Rambo, que con los años se ha convertido para Gabriela en una verdadera figura paterna, emprende un desesperado y peligroso viaje para encontrarla.

results.title: The Nun II

results.title: The Mummy: Tomb of the Dragon Emperor
results.original_title: The Mummy: Tomb of the Dragon Emperor
results.overview: Archaeologist Rick O'Connell travels to China, pitting him against an emperor from the 2,000-year-old Han dynasty who's returned from the dead to pursue a quest for world domination. This time, O'Connell enlists the help of his wife and son to quash the so-called 'Dragon Emperor' and his abuse of supernatural power.

results.title: The Castle of Cagliostro
results.original_title: ルパン三世 カリオストロの城
results.overview: After a successful robbery leaves famed thief Lupin the Third and his partner Jigen with nothing but a large amount of expertly crafted counterfeit bills, he decides to track down the forgers responsible—and steal any other treasures he may find in the Castle of Cagliostro, including the 'damsel in distress' he finds imprisoned there.

results.title: La monja II
results.overview: 1956 – Francia. Un sacerdote es asesinado. Un mal se está extendiendo. La hermana Irene una vez más se encuentra cara a cara con Valak, la monja demonio.

results.title: Orphan: First Kill
results.overview: After escaping from an Estonian psychiatric facility, Leena Klammer travels to America by impersonating Esther, the missing daughter of a wealthy family. But when her mask starts to slip, she is put against a mother who will protect her family from the murderous “child” at any cost.

results.title: La huérfana: El origen
results.overview: Después de escapar de un centro psiquiátrico de Estonia, Leena Klammer viaja a Estados Unidos haciéndose pasar por Esther, la hija desaparecida de una familia adinerada. Pero cuando su máscara comienza a deslizarse, se enfrenta a una madre que protegerá a su familia del "niño" asesino a toda costa.

results.title: Mortal Kombat II
results.overview: Los campeones favoritos de los fans —ahora acompañados por el mismísimo Johnny Cage— se enfrentan entre sí en la batalla definitiva, sangrienta y sin reglas, para derrotar el oscuro dominio de Shao Kahn, que amenaza con destruir el Reino de la Tierra y a sus defensores.

results.title: Mortal Kombat
results.overview: Durante nueve generaciones, Shang Tsung, un brujo malvado, ha llevado a un poderoso príncipe a la victoria contra sus mortales enemigos. Si vence el décimo torneo Mortal Kombat, la desolación y el mal que han florecido en el mundo exterior reinarán la Tierra por siempre.

results.title: Mortal Kombat
results.overview: Un boxeador fracasado descubre un secreto familiar que le lleva a un torneo místico llamado Mortal Kombat donde conoce a un grupo de guerreros que luchan a muerte para salvar los reinos del malvado hechicero Shang Tsung.

results.name: Mortal Kombat: Legacy
results.overview: Serie online basada en el famoso corto dirigido por Kevin Tancharoen en 2010 que imaginaba la historia de los videojuegos Mortal Kombat desde un punto de vista sobrio y adulto, "Mortal Kombat: Rebirth".

results.title: Mortal Kombat: Aniquilación
results.overview: Estamos en el universo del Emperador Shao-Khan, donde las reglas no existen y la vida es una continua batalla. Los esbirros del maquiavélico Khan han sido adiestrados para matar y están dispuestos a cumplir las órdenes de su amo, conseguir el control de la Tierra para iniciar su aniquilación total. Un héroe, llamado Liu Kang, les hará frente.

results.name: Mortal Kombat Defensores Del Reino
results.original_name: Mortal Kombat: Defenders of the Realm
results.overview: Las Fuerzas Oscuras al invadir la Tierra, hacen que la pared dimensional se esté debilitando. Solo los Defensores del Reino podrán parar esto en un Mortal Kombat.

results.title: Mortal Kombat Leyends: Frío y Penumbra
results.overview: El despiadado y sediento de poder Kano está decidido a conquistar el Reino de la Tierra de a un alma por vez. Acompañado de tres fríos mercenarios del clan Dragón Negro, ataca en forma brutal a todos los pueblos indefensos. La elección es simple: rendición o muerte. Kenshi, un guerrero rebelde, pide ayuda a Kuai Liang, el único con la fuerza suficiente para enfrentar al malevolente Kano. Pero los días de guerrero de Kuai Liang habían quedado atrás y Kenshi tiene muy poca disciplina como para derrotar a Kano sin ayuda. Si Kuai Liang no logra romper el glaciar de dudas que lo retiene, el Reino de la Tierra caerá. Hay mucho en juego, y ¡las posibles consecuencias nunca han sido tan nefastas!

results.title: Mortal Kombat Legends - Demonios y Ángeles
results.overview: En el Hollywood de la década de 1980, el actor de artes marciales Johnny Cage busca a su coprotagonista desaparecido en medio de un Los Ángeles lleno de luchadores sedientos de sangre.

results.title: Mortal Kombat Leyendas: La Venganza De Scorpion
results.overview: Basado en el popular videojuego creado por Ed Boon y John Tovias, Mortal Kombat Legends: Scorpion’s Revenge pone el foco en un torneo único que se celebra una vez por generación y en el que se enfrentan los campeones de distintos reinos. El ganador determinará el destino de la Tierra y de sus habitantes.

results.title: Mortal Kombat Leyendas: La Batalla de los Reinos
results.original_title: Mortal Kombat Legends: Battle of the Realms
results.overview: La historia toma lugar casi un año después de los eventos de Mortal Kombat Legends: La venganza de Scorpion, Tras la derrota del mundo exterior en el torneo del Mortal Kombat (Kombate Mortal) el poderoso emperador de este llamado Shao Kahn decide tomar este asunto en sus propias manos y para ello reúne a sus mejores comandantes, mientras en el reino de la Tierra el dios del trueno Raiden intenta completar el entrenamiento de Liu Kang al mismo tiempo que reúne a todos los mejores peleadores de la Tierra para que luchen en el inevitable conflicto.

results.name: The Batman
results.overview: A young billionaire Bruce Wayne fights crime and evil as the mysterious vigilante, The Batman.

results.title: The Batman
results.overview: In his second year of fighting crime, Batman uncovers corruption in Gotham City that connects to his own family while facing a serial killer known as the Riddler.

results.name: Batman: The Animated Series
results.overview: Vowing to avenge the murder of his parents, Bruce Wayne devotes his life to wiping out crime in Gotham City as the masked vigilante "Batman".

results.name: Batman: The Brave and the Bold
results.original_name: Batman: The Brave and the Bold
results.overview: The Caped Crusader is teamed up with Blue Beetle, Green Arrow, Aquaman and countless others in his quest to uphold justice.

results.name: Beware the Batman
results.overview: Set during Bruce Wayne's early years as the Batman, following his initial period of battling organized crime. He hones his skills with the assistance of his butler, Alfred Pennyworth. Bruce is introduced to Alfred's goddaughter, Tatsu Yamashiro. Tatsu is a martial arts swordsmaster hired to act as Bruce's bodyguard, but also recruited to act as a superhero partner to Batman.

results.name: The New Batman Adventures
results.overview: After a long hiatus -- The Caped Crusader is back and cooler then ever, in the animated action-packed series -- The New Batman Adventures. Picking up years after Batman: The Animated Series, the series highlights Batman and his crimefighting cadre of Nightwing, Robin and Batgirl, as they join forces to battle Gotham City's classic super-villains.

results.title: The Lego Batman Movie
results.overview: A cooler-than-ever Batman must face the usual villains as the Joker plots a takeover of Gotham City. But when Bruce Wayne accidentally adopts a teenage orphan who wishes to become his sidekick, he’s forced to give up his lone-vigilante ways and learn to work with others.

results.name: The Adventures of Batman
results.overview: The adventures of Batman, with Robin, the Boy Wonder! Batman and Robin, the Dynamic Duo against crime and corruption, whose real identities as millionaire philanthropist Bruce Wayne and his young ward Dick Grayson and known only to Alfred, the faithful butler. Ever alert, they respond swiftly to a signal from the police, and moments later, from the secret Batcave deep beneath Wayne Manor, they roar out to protect life, limb and property as Batman and Robin, caped crimefighters! Batman and Robin, scourge of Gotham City's kooky criminals: The Joker, Clown Prince of Crime - The Penguin, pudgy purveyor of perfidy - and the cool, cruel, Mr. Freeze! Watch out, villains, here come... Batman and Robin!

results.title: The Batman: Part II
results.overview: Sequel to the 2022 film The Batman.

results.title: Batman: The Killing Joke
results.overview: As Batman hunts for the escaped Joker, the Clown Prince of Crime attacks the Gordon family to prove a diabolical point mirroring his own fall into madness.

results.name: Pennyworth: The Origin of Batman's Butler
results.original_name: Pennyworth: The Origin of Batman's Butler
results.overview: The origin story of Bruce Wayne's legendary butler, Alfred Pennyworth, a former British SAS soldier who forms a security company in 1960s London and goes to work with young billionaire Thomas Wayne and his wife Martha, before they become Bruce Wayne’s parents.

results.title: Batman: Mask of the Phantasm
results.overview: Andrea Beaumont leaves her father to return to Gotham, rekindling an old romance with Bruce Wayne. At the same time, a mysterious figure begins to hunt down Gotham's criminals, wrongly implicating Batman in the murders. Now on the run from the law, Batman must find and stop the culprit, while also navigating his relationship with Andrea.

results.name: The New Adventures of Batman
results.overview: The Dynamic Duo fights crime in Gotham City, encountering the classic Batman rogues gallery as well as some original villains. Complicating matters is Bat-Mite, a well meaning imp from another dimension called Ergo, who considers himself Batman's biggest fan.

results.title: Batman: Under the Red Hood
results.overview: One part vigilante, one part criminal kingpin, Red Hood begins cleaning up Gotham with the efficiency of Batman, but without following the same ethical code.

results.title: The Batman vs. Dracula
results.overview: Gotham City is terrorized not only by recent escapees Joker and Penguin, but by the original creature of the night, Dracula! Can Batman stop the ruthless vampire before he turns everyone in the city, including The Caped Crusader, Joker and Penguin, into his mindless minions?

results.title: Batman Beyond: The Movie
results.overview: Fuelled by remorse and vengeance, a high schooler named Terry McGinnis becomes the new Batman as he fights crime in the futuristic Neo-Gotham City.

results.title: Batman: Mystery of the Batwoman
results.overview: As if the Penguin wasn't enough to contend with, a new vigilante has surfaced in Gotham City, and her strong-arm tactics give Batman cause for concern. Being the World's Greatest Detective and The Dark Knight, he sets out to uncover her identity while stopping a dangerous criminal plot.

results.title: Batman: Soul of the Dragon
results.overview: Bruce Wayne faces a deadly menace from his past, with the help of three former classmates: world-renowned martial artists Richard Dragon, Ben Turner and Lady Shiva.

results.title: Batman: The Long Halloween, Part Two
results.original_title: Batman: The Long Halloween, Part Two
results.overview: As Gotham City's young vigilante, the Batman, struggles to pursue a brutal serial killer, district attorney Harvey Dent gets caught in a feud involving the criminal family of the Falcones.

results.title: Batman Beyond: Return of the Joker
results.original_title: Batman Beyond: Return of the Joker
results.overview: The Joker is back with a vengeance, and Neo-Gotham's Dark Knight, Terry McGinnis, needs answers as he stands alone to face the old Gotham's most infamous Clown Prince of Crime.

results.name: Batman
results.overview: El millonario Bruno Díaz y su pupilo Ricardo Tapia se dedican a luchar contra el mal ocultando su identidad bajo las máscaras de Batman y Robin.

results.title: Batman
results.overview: Cuando un asesino se dirige a la élite de Gotham con una serie de maquinaciones sádicas, un rastro de pistas crípticas envía Batman a una investigación en los bajos fondos. A medida que las pruebas comienzan a acercarse a su casa y se hace evidente la magnitud de los planes del autor, Batman debe forjar nuevas relaciones, desenmascarar al culpable y hacer justicia al abuso de poder y la corrupción que durante mucho tiempo han asolado Gotham City.

results.name: Batman del futuro
results.overview: Impulsado por el remordimiento y la venganza, un estudiante de secundaria llamado Terry McGinnis revive el papel de Batman. Bajo la supervisión de un anciano Bruno Diaz, lucha contra el crimen en una Gótica dura y futurista.

results.name: Batman: La Serie Animada
results.overview: Considerada la mejor adaptación de Batman a la pantalla, esta serie de Bruce W. Timm narraba en un tono oscuro y adulto la historia del héroe de DC Comics, Batman, presentando una Gotham inspirada en la de la película de Tim Burton.

results.title: Batman inicia
results.overview: Después de entrenar con su mentor, Batman comienza su lucha para liberar a Ciudad Gótica de la corrupción.

results.name: The Batman
results.overview: Un joven Bruce Wayne/Bruno Diaz está en su tercer año de tratar de establecerse como Batman, protector de Gotham City. Vivir en Gotham, una metrópolis donde las sombras corren largo y profundo, por debajo de las vías del tren elevado, este joven Batman se enfrentará a cada uno de sus viejos conocidos, por primera vez.

results.name: Batman: El enmascarado
results.overview: Bienvenidos a Ciudad Gótica, donde los delincuentes se mueven a sus anchas y los ciudadanos decentes viven con temor. Forjado en el fuego de la tragedia, el sofisticado multimillonario Bruce Wayne se transforma en Batman, un personaje a la vez más y menos que humano. Su solitaria cruzada contra el mal atrae aliados de la policía y la alcaldía, pero sus actos heroicos tienen ramificaciones letales.

results.title: Batman
results.overview: La oscura y peligrosa Ciudad Gótica se halla protegida por su corrupto cuerpo de policía. A pesar de los esfuerzos del fiscal del distrito Harvey Dent y el comisionado de policía Jim Gordon, la ciudad es cada vez más insegura hasta que aparece Batman, el Señor de la Noche. La reconocida periodista Vicky Vale intentará descubrir el secreto que se oculta tras el hombre murciélago.

results.name: Batman, el Valiente
results.original_name: Batman: The Brave and the Bold
results.overview: En cada episodio de la serie se muestra Batman trabajando en conjunto con algún otro superhéroe (del universo DC), juntos frustraran la malvados planes de algún villano, o resolverán un crimen. Dado que cada episodio es más una mini historia, la serie no cuenta con una trama general. En esta adaptación se muestra a Batman de una manera más ligera y humorística, y no tan seria y oscura.

results.title: Batman regresa
results.overview: Cuando un empresario corrupto y el grotesco Pingüino tratan de tomar el control de Ciudad Gótica, sólo Batman puede detenerlos, mientras que Gatúbela tiene sus propios planes.

results.name: Cuidado con Batman
results.overview: La serie se desarrolla durante los primeros años de Bruce Wayne como Batman, después de su período inicial de lucha contra el crimen organizado. A lo largo de la temporada, perfecciona sus habilidades con la ayuda de su mayordomo, Alfred Pennyworth. Bruce conoce a la ahijada de Alfred, Tatsu Yamashiro. Tatsu es un espadachín de artes marciales contratado para actuar como guardaespaldas de Bruce, pero también reclutado para actuar como socio superhéroe de Batman.

results.name: Las Nuevas Aventuras de Batman
results.overview: Serie sucesora de "Batman: La serie animada", creada por Bruce W. Timm y considerada la adaptación más fiel del personaje de DC Comics al mundo audiovisual. Las historias de esta nueva serie suelen relacionarse con los personajes secundarios de Batman, que incluyen a Robin, Nightwing y Batgirl, entre otros. Además, la serie presenta como invitados a Supergirl, Etrigan y Creeper, personajes que aparecieron más tarde junto a Batman en Liga de la Justicia y Liga de la Justicia Ilimitada.

results.title: Batman eternamente
results.overview: Batman debe luchar contra el ex fiscal de distrito Harvey Dent, que ahora es Dos Caras y Edward Nygma, El Acertijo. Batman contará ahora con un nuevo interés amoroso y un joven acróbata de circo que queda huérfano y se convierte en su compañero: Robin.

results.title: Batman: Knightfall Part 1: Knightfall
results.overview: Cuando el misterioso gigante conocido únicamente como Bane libera a toda la galería de villanos de Batman del Manicomio de Arkham, el Cruzado Encapuchado se ve llevado al límite de su resistencia física y mental.

results.title: Batman & Robin
results.overview: Los experimentos del doctor Victor Fries, mediante los cuales busca conservar criogénicamente la vida de su esposa, originan un error fatal que lo convierte en el señor Frío, un villano que necesita mantener su cuerpo a temperaturas glaciales y que intentará congelar a todos los habitantes de Ciudad Gótica. Además, en el transcurso de un experimento, la tímida botánica Pamela Isley se transforma en la terrible Hiedra Venenosa, que tratará de asesinar a todos los seres humanos para que las plantas recuperen su hegemonía sobre la Tierra. Batman y su compañero Robin deberán enfrentarse a ellos para hacer fracasar sus siniestros planes.

results.title: Batman vs Superman: El Origen de la Justicia
results.original_title: Batman v Superman: Dawn of Justice
results.overview: Dos años después de la destrucción de Metrópolis, la humanidad aún intenta determinar el rol de Superman en el mundo. Para evitar que las acciones del Hombre de Acero pasen desapercibidas, Batman se enfrenta a Superman, mientras una amenaza surge de las sombras.

results.title: Batman
results.overview: Adaptación a la gran pantalla del popular cómic de Bob Kane, que ese mismo año y con los mismos protagonistas conocía una exitosa versión en formato de serie de televisión que duraría dos años en la pequeña pantalla. Batman y Robin se enfrentan a un grupo de criminales entre los que se encuentran sus eternos rivales Joker y El Pingüino, quienes se han apoderado de un sofisticado artilugio para dominar el mundo.

results.title: Batman: El caballero de la noche
results.overview: Cuando la amenaza conocida como el Joker causa estragos y caos en la gente de Ciudad Gótica, Batman debe aceptar una de las mayores pruebas psicológicas y físicas de su capacidad para luchar contra la injusticia.

results.title: Lego Batman: la película
results.overview: Con el irreverente espíritu de diversión que convirtió a "The Lego Movie" en un fenómeno mundial, el autodenominado protagonista de ese conjunto, Lego Batman, protagoniza su propia aventura en la gran pantalla. Pero se están gestando grandes cambios en Ciudad Gótica, y si quiere salvar a la ciudad de la invasión hostil de The Joker, Batman puede tener que dejar a un lado al vigilante, tratar de trabajar con otros y tal vez, solo tal vez, aprender a alegrarse.

results.name: Las aventuras de Batman
results.overview: ¡Las aventuras de Batman, con Robin, el joven Maravilla! Batman y Robin, el Dúo Dinámico contra el crimen y la corrupción, cuyas verdaderas identidades son el filántropo millonario Bruce Wayne y su joven pupilo Dick Grayson, que solo conoce Alfred, el fiel mayordomo. Siempre alertas, responden rápidamente a una señal de la policía, y momentos después, desde la Baticueva secreta en las profundidades de la Mansión Wayne, rugen para proteger la vida, la integridad física y la propiedad como Batman y Robin, ¡Luchadores contra el crimen con capa! Batman y Robin, azote de los locos criminales de Gotham City: El Guasón, el Príncipe Payaso del Crimen, el Pingüino, el regordete proveedor de perfidia, y el genial y cruel Mr. Freeze! Cuidado, villanos, aquí vienen... ¡Batman y Robin!

results.title: Law Abiding Citizen
results.overview: A frustrated man decides to take justice into his own hands after a plea bargain sets one of his family's killers free. He targets not only the killer but also the district attorney and others involved in the deal.

results.title: A Law-Abiding Citizen
results.overview: A young man who grew up beneath the heavy shade of autocratic and avaricious mother, son Gregory, has lost initiative and the minimum footprint. The servility of his mother against his boss, which facilitates the solicitations of the latter to his sister, infuriates him. The fiancée, Soula, can not understand his sexual desires and his girlfriend, Julia, the only one that loves him really forced to abandon him. Gregory wonder with all this and rebels, but his rebellion brings him to the brink of madness. When you finally meet, forced to follow the commands of the mother and uncle ultraconservative so he marries the woman who suggest those.

results.title: The Best of Beavis and Butt-Head: Law-Abiding Citizens / There Goes The Neighborhood
results.original_title: The Best of Beavis and Butt-Head: Law-Abiding Citizens / There Goes The Neighborhood
results.overview: Law-Abiding Citizens: Beavis and Butt-head are not criminals.  They're just innocent teenagers, guilty of trying to have a good time.  Whether they're meeting president Clinton, attempting to "do it" with an undercover prostitute, or Beavis transforming into his unpredictable alter-ego, The Great Cornholio, they prove time and time again that it's not easy enforcing the law on two boys who clearly don't know what the law is.  There Goes The Neighborhood: How would you like to live next door to Beavis and Butt-head?  Don't answer until you've seen these eight classic episodes featuring Beavis and Butt-head's most victimized neighbor, Tom Anderson!

results.name: El Vengador
results.overview: Steel Jeeg, más comúnmente conocido como Kotetsu Jeeg o Koutetsu Jeeg, es una serie de anime y manga de súper robots creada por los artistas de manga Go Nagai y Tatsuya Yasuda. La serie de televisión anime fue producida por Toei Doga. Fue transmitido por primera vez en la televisión japonesa en 1975. La serie duró 46 episodios. Steel Jeeg también actuó como manga en varias publicaciones infantiles. Una serie de secuelas llamada Kotetsushin Jeeg se difundió en la red de satélites WOWOW, a partir del 5 de abril de 2007.

results.title: El vengador
results.overview: Un hombre frustrado decide tomar la justicia por su cuenta después de que un acuerdo de culpabilidad libere a uno de los asesinos de su familia.

results.name: Criminal el Vengador
results.overview: Alejandro, chofer de oficio, trabaja al lado de su padre para sostener a sus seres queridos y a su novia, próxima a tener su primer hijo. De manera humilde pero honesta, padre e hijo sostienen una relación basada en los valores familiares y la integridad como individuos, pero un golpe del destino lleva a Alejandro a ser testigo mudo de un crimen y es visto por los agresores justo cuando está abandonando el lugar en el carro que les da su sustento.

results.title: El vengador del futuro
results.overview: La Tierra, año 2084. Doug Quaid, un hombre que lleva una vida aparentemente tranquila, vive atormentado por una pesadilla que todas las noches lo transporta a Marte. Decide entonces recurrir al laboratorio de Recall, una empresa de vacaciones virtuales que le ofrece la oportunidad de materializar su sueño gracias a un fuerte alucinógeno, pero la droga hace aflorar a su memoria una estancia verdadera en Marte cuando era el más temido agente del cruel Coohagen.

results.title: El vengador tóxico
results.overview: Un chico ingenuo se transforma en un poderoso superhéroe después de ser arrojado a una tina de desechos tóxicos.

results.title: El vengador del futuro
results.overview: Bienvenido a Rekall, la compañía que puede convertir tus sueños en recuerdos reales. Para un obrero llamado Douglas Quaid, a pesar de que tiene una hermosa esposa a la que ama, el viaje mental suena como las vacaciones perfectas de su frustrante vida: los verdaderos recuerdos de la vida como super espía podrían ser justo lo que necesita. Pero cuando el procedimiento sale mal, Quaid se convierte en un hombre perseguido. Al encontrarse huyendo de la policía, controlada por el canciller Cohaagen, el líder del mundo libre, Quaid se alía con un luchador rebelde para encontrar al jefe de la resistencia clandestina y detener a Cohaagen. La línea entre la fantasía y la realidad se difumina y el destino de su mundo se mantiene en el equilibrio cuando Quaid descubre su verdadera identidad, su verdadero amor y su verdadero destino.

results.title: Priest - El vengador
results.overview: En un mundo asolado por siglos de guerra entre el hombre y los vampiros, Paul Bettany es un legendario guerrero que destacó durante la última Guerra del Vampiro, pero ahora es sólo un sacerdote que vive en compañía de otros hombres en las amuralladas ciudades distópicas controladas por la Iglesia. Sin embargo, cuando su joven sobrina es secuestrada por un grupo de vampiros asesinos que viven en los páramos desolados del exterior, el sacerdote rompe sus sagrados votos y emprende su búsqueda decidido a vengarse de los secuestradores, especialmente de su brutal líder. En esta aventura le acompaña Hicks, el novio de la chica, un sheriff y una sacerdotisa, miembro de la legión de asesinos de vampiros y poseedora de habilidades de combate sobrenaturales.

results.title: El vengador
results.overview: Félix llega de Europa a la hacienda de su padre, recientemente fallecido, y encuentra a su madre casada con su tío Félix, hermano de su padre. El joven se va molesto al pueblo en donde descubre las pistas que demuestran que su tío es el verdadero asesino de su padre a quien querrá vengar.

results.title: Ghost Rider: el vengador fantasma
results.overview: Cuando el motociclista Johnny Blaze vende su alma al Diablo para salvar la vida de su padre, se transforma en el Vengador Fantasma, el cazador de recompensas del Diablo, y es enviado a cazar pecadores.

results.title: Capitán América: El Primer Vengador
results.overview: Steve Rogers, un soldado militar rechazado, se transforma en el Capitán América después de tomar una dosis de un «suero de Súper-Soldado». Pero ser el Capitán América tiene un precio cuando intenta acabar con un belicista y una organización terrorista.

results.title: El gavilan vengador
results.overview: En el México rural, una despiadada banda de forajidos aterroriza a los rancheros y campesinos locales, robando ganado y dinero por toda la región. Para detenerlos, Mauricio Rosales adopta la identidad secreta de «El Gavilán», un justiciero enmascarado que lucha por proteger a los inocentes. Mientras arriesga su vida contra los criminales, Mauricio debe fingir ser un hombre tímido y cobarde, ocultando su verdadero heroísmo incluso a su propio padre y a su prima Carmela, quien desprecia su aparente falta de valor mientras admira al misterioso héroe enmascarado.

results.title: El justiciero vengador
results.overview: El norteño y sus amigos se disfrazan de monjes y abren un templo qu había sido cerrado por el impío Fernando con la intencíon de hacer justicia por el asesinato de Luisito, a quien Fernando eliminó para poder quedarse con una mina.

results.title: El chicano vengador
results.overview: Dos policías investigan una serie de raptos de mujeres, pero tropiezan con algunos obstáculos que les pone su jefe. Los policías deciden convertirse en El chicano vengador, y así van descubriendo que los delincuentes son contrabandistas de drogas y que el jefe que los obstaculiza es su cómplice. Finalmente acaban con la banda.

results.title: El vengador de Sinaloa
results.overview: Rafael, único testigo de la masacre de su hermano mayor y sus padres, se propone vengarse de los delincuentes. Se hace pasar por muerto con la ayuda de su cómplice el doctor Gómez, para lograr su objetivo.

results.title: El vengador anónimo
results.overview: Tras sufrir una brutal agresión su mujer y su hija, Paul Kersey, un ciudadano normal de Nueva York, decide vengarse acosando a todos los delincuentes de la ciudad que actúan por la noche.

results.name: Las estrellas afrodescendientes más influyentes de Hollywood
results.original_name: Number One on the Call Sheet
results.overview: Algunas de las mayores estrellas de Hollywood revelan sus procesos hacia los protagónicos que cambiaron el juego. En entrevistas sinceras, sacan a la luz los altos y bajos de su profesión, sus momentos de descubrimiento, los planos para le éxito y el gran potencial de la próxima generación.

results.title: Inside Man
results.overview: When an armed, masked gang enter a Manhattan bank, lock the doors and take hostages, the detective assigned to effect their release enters negotiations preoccupied with corruption charges he is facing.

results.name: Inside Man
results.overview: A prisoner on death row in the US, a vicar in a quiet English town, and a maths teacher trapped in a cellar cross paths in the most unexpected way.

results.name: A Man on the Inside
results.overview: A retired professor with a knack for snooping gets a new lease on life when a private investigator recruits him to go undercover and crack a case.

results.name: Inside Man
results.overview: After 1945, intelligence officer Shen Fang returns to the Kuomintang bureau to expose traitors, recover secret plans, and stop a deadly conspiracy. Haunted by past injuries and strained family ties, he and his brother Shen Lin must navigate a dangerous web of espionage and deception. As hidden plots come to light, the brothers fight to survive and outsmart their enemies, racing against time to secure victory.

results.name: The Inside Man
results.overview: Meet Mark, a man with secrets. This lonely hacker must blag his way into Khromacom's security team and destroy the company. His new colleagues present a heartbreaking dilemma: satisfy his sinister controller or betray his loveable friends?

results.title: Inside Man
results.overview: Based on true events. A disgraced police detective seeking redemption goes undercover to expose a violent crime syndicate. But as he sinks deeper into the mob, the price for absolution may be higher than he can afford.

results.title: Inside Man: Most Wanted
results.overview: An NYPD hostage negotiator teams up with a federal agent to rescue dozens of tourists held hostage during a 10-hour seige at the U.S. Federal Reserve.

results.name: The Inside Man
results.overview: The Inside Man, produced by Derek Granger and David Cunliffe, offers more of a reimagining than a direct replacement of its predecessor's concept. The series features Frederick Jaeger as Dr. James Austen, a psychiatrist and criminologist who alternates between working for Basil Henson's character, Dawnay, from "the Department," and taking on cases from private clients. Petra Davies plays Sarah Worth, Austen's dependable 'girl Friday.' In the third episode, *Crosscheck*, Robin Ellis joins the cast as Michael Barnett, a spy whom the Department insists Austen should approve. However, every detail about Barnett is an obvious fabrication, adding layers of intrigue to the storyline.

results.name: Inside Man
results.overview: Documentary filmmaker Morgan Spurlock provides an insider's view of diverse social and economic issues facing Americans today.

results.title: The Inside Man
results.original_title: The Inside Man - Un uomo all'interno
results.overview: Ulisse, following his father's death, inherits a bar frequented by motorcyclists. One day, unusual events convince him that there is a drug courier among his customers.

results.title: The Inside Man
results.overview: In 1981, after the successful test of a submarine tracker device developed by the Swedish scientist Paul Mandell and sponsored by the US government through his representative Miller, his industry is totally burned and the laser device is stolen. Stig Larsson from the Swedish Secret Agency suspects of an inside job and brings the Swedish Marine Thomas Kallin to investigate Paul undercover as his driver. The naive Kallin is double-crossed but continues his investigation while Larsson finds the truth about the heist.

results.title: The Man Inside
results.overview: A detective tracking a stolen gem begins to suspect there's more to the case than just theft.

results.title: The Man Inside
results.overview: A thriller centered on a young boxer trying to distance himself from his father's gangster past and the relationship with his trainer.

results.title: Auschwitz: The Inside Man
results.overview: The incredible untold story of Witold Pilecki, a Polish officer who managed to infiltrate the Auschwitz death camp to smuggle information. Here is the story of one of the greatest resistance fighters of the Second World War.

results.title: A Man Inside
results.overview: A middle aged man taunted by his young office colleagues about his bachelorhood turns to violence.

results.title: The Man Inside
results.overview: Gunter Wallraff is a journalist seeking to expose the unethical journalism practiced by The Standard, a very popular and powerful German newspaper. He goes undercover, using forged identity papers and at great personal risk, to join their staff. Once there, he sees how they don't just report the news, but manufacture it to suit the personal political agenda of the paper's leaders.

results.title: The Man Inside
results.overview: Years after Barry Thornton disappears from Panama while under suspicion of stealing American defense plans for the canal, his daughter Eleanor, now the ward of Barry's twin brother Dana, is still obsessed with the mystery. Senator Carew informs her that he has solved it, but he is murdered before he can give her the details.

results.title: The Man Inside
results.overview: When Lisandro's key breaks in the lock one morning, he finds himself trapped inside his tenth floor apartment. Struggling against time and the locked door to avoid being late for work, Lisandro begins to realize his predicament is considerably more serious than he thought.

results.title: The Man Inside
results.overview: An undercover cop infiltrates a major heroin ring. He soon finds himself in a position to take $2 million without anyone knowing about it, a situation made all the more tempting because of his girlfriend's griping about their constant struggles to make ends meet and their need to change their lives for the better.

results.title: The Man Inside Dame Edna
results.overview: A character portrait of the enigmatic comedian Barry Humphries on his most recent Australian tour and an examination of the connections to his two most famous alter egos, Dame Edna and Sir Les Patterson. Interviews include Bruce Beresford and Geoffrey Rush.

results.title: El Plan Perfecto
results.overview: Duelo entre un duro policía y un inteligente atracador durante un tenso secuestro con rehenes en un banco de Manhattan. De repente, aparece una tercera persona que ha sido contratada por el influyente propietario del banco. Se trata de Madaline, una poderosa bróker que tiene una agenda secreta.

results.name: El plan perfecto
results.overview: Duelo entre un duro policía (Denzel Washington) y un inteligente atracador (Clive Owen) durante un tenso secuestro con rehenes en un banco de Manhattan. De repente, aparece una tercera persona que ha sido contratada por el influyente propietario del banco (Christopher Plummer). Se trata de Madaline (Jodie Foster), una poderosa bróker que tiene una agenda secreta.

results.title: El Plan Perfecto
results.overview: Cuenta la vida de seis compañeros de trabajo que laboran en un viejo almacén de Santo Domingo, y que por cuestiones de salud el dueño, se ve compelido a venderlo, recibiendo una oferta de compra en la cual las operaciones de dicho almacén cambian de administrador, comenzando a operar, de manera clandestina, un centro de acopio de mercancía ilegal, cuestión que les trae serios problemas a estos empleados.

results.title: El Plan Perfecto:  El Más Buscado
results.overview: Un negociador de rehenes de la policía de Nueva York se asocia con un agente federal para rescatar a docenas de turistas retenidos como rehenes durante un asedio de 10 horas en la Reserva Federal de los Estados Unidos. Secuela de la película de 2006 Inside Man.

results.title: Un Plan Perfecto
results.overview: Al jefe de una banda de atracadores de joyerías (Gene Hackman), un mafioso muy amigo suyo (Danny de Vito) le encarga un gran golpe. Pero, a pesar de su larga amistad, el mafioso envía a su sobrino para supervisar el plan, que ha sido meticulosamente preparado, y para evitar que alguien se escape con el botín.

results.title: Un crimen nada perfecto
results.overview: Una comedia se centró en tres guardas de seguridad del museo que idean un plan de robar atrás las ilustraciones a las cuales se han hecho adjuntos después de que se transfieren a otro museo.

results.title: El Engaño
results.overview: Una rica y exitosa Bryce conoce a la bella Lissa en un bar una noche y la invita a volver a su casa, sin sospechar por un momento que Lissa no es realmente quien parece. Lo que se desarrolla a continuación es una red peligrosa y enredada de traiciones y seducción.

data.title: El Plan Perfecto
data.overview: Duelo entre un duro policía y un inteligente atracador durante un tenso secuestro con rehenes en un banco de Manhattan. De repente, aparece una tercera persona que ha sido contratada por el influyente propietario del banco. Se trata de Madaline, una poderosa bróker que tiene una agenda secreta.
